runtime_check: python -m cerebrobase preflight --config <cfg> [--phase pre-migrate|pre-start]  (validates the real config; writes nothing but creates missing private/runtime dirs and a removed probe file)
lock: No third-party packages. Lock = exact CPython minor (3.12 or 3.13) + SQLite >= 3.35 checked at preflight.

dependencies.name: sqlite
dependencies.requirement: SQLite >= 3.35, transactional DDL, foreign keys, upsert

dependencies.name: root:private_data_root
dependencies.requirement: writable, outside public_assets_root, outside PROD roots when STAGING

dependencies.name: root:db_path
dependencies.requirement: parent writable; DB outside public root; never the Postkasse DB

dependencies.name: listener
dependencies.requirement: numeric loopback bind free (no wildcard; synthetic auth loopback only)

dependencies.name: build
dependencies.requirement: installed files hash to BUILD_INFO build_id == config build_id

dependencies.name: auth_adapter
dependencies.requirement: SYNTHETIC in DEV/STAGING (test identities only); a qualified EXTERNAL AuthProvider before any real user / PROD

dependencies.name: deployment_qualification
dependencies.requirement: PM effect approval + A1 EDGE/Caddy readback

dependencies.name: tool:postkasse.lese
dependencies.requirement: owner-supplied attested port + dependencies + allowed operation + custody readback

dependencies.name: secret_refs
dependencies.requirement: env:NAME or file:/abs owner-controlled file; never inline/repo/Drive/logs
